scope: Corrections to machine-generated vowel marks in their immediate syntax; these are not authorial vocalizations or manuscript textual variants.

rules.reason: The second complement of هدانا is accusative; الطريق is the genitive complement of سواء.
الأفهام is genitive as the complement of لدى.
Conjoined to تبصرةً in جعلته تبصرةً ... وتذكرةً; both objects are accusative.
This is the noun تصوّر parallel to تصديق, not the imperfect verb تصوّر.
Noun of signification (تضمّن) parallel to مطابقة and التزام, not a finite verb.
النّاقل is governed by the preposition إلى.
